scientific_role: Operational validity prerequisite; composite is only evaluated on successfully processed rows
known_limitations: Operational status is not itself a noise metric; it only guards against scoring error rows.

scientific_role: Data sufficiency prerequisite and conservative support modifier
known_limitations: Captures point count only; does not fully encode cadence gaps or baseline coverage.

scientific_role: Step/discontinuity stability component; lower values indicate smoother residual behavior
known_limitations: Single summary of first-difference roughness; can miss other structured noise modes.

scientific_role: Primary autocorrelation/whiteness effect-size component; lower values are closer to white residuals
known_limitations: Still limited to short-lag autocorrelation structure; may not capture all K2 systematics by itself.

scientific_role: Semantic guard to ensure the whiteness fields are interpreted on the correct scale
known_limitations: A mode label is not a quality metric; it only protects interpretation.

scientific_role: Interpretation guard documenting which whiteness definition produced the row
known_limitations: Descriptive metadata only; does not itself improve stability assessment.

scientific_role: Diagnostic escalation flag for the regime where p-value semantics became numerically extreme
known_limitations: Only meaningful in p-value mode; not a standalone scientific descriptor.

scientific_role: Optional support feature summarizing whether the detector found actionable event structure in the row
known_limitations: Detector output rather than a pure noise metric; should not dominate the composite or override stability failures.

scientific_role: Optional diagnostic severity trace for underflowed p-value mode; used for audit and review context
known_limitations: Retained for transparency only; not suitable as the main policy input because it inherits the current p-value framing.

scientific_role: Optional diagnostic trace of autocorrelation test magnitude; used for review context
known_limitations: Sample-size-amplified quantity; not appropriate as the primary policy driver.

scientific_role: Legacy diagnostic text used for side-by-side validation against the current official policy
known_limitations: Carries current-policy language and should not be fed back into the new composite as a scored input.
